title: Mopeka Propane Tank Propane Level Leaderboard
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mopeka:tank propane_pct=*
| stats sum(propane_pct) as total_value, avg(propane_pct) as avg_value by tank_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tank name values by total and average propane level across Mopeka propane tank events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `propane_pct` values for each Mopeka propane tank event and review total and average propane level by tank name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total propane level.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which tank name shows the biggest propane level numbers in your Mopeka propane tank data.
